instances.claim: This tells me that the cent had stopped being a thing — that its physical existence had come into question, and that something other than its substance was holding it in being.
instances.why: "The object" is a definite phrase with nothing before it that names an object: lines 1–3 give a price, a metal value, and a disappearance of purchasing power, all of which concern what a cent is worth, not whether it is a thing. "Remained" and "buoyed into physicality" then both push against a state the draft never establishes, so the line reads as the resolution of an argument about objecthood that is not in the piece.
